source_refs.note: Exercise 11.3, Question 6: book page 295. The book prints no answers for Unit 11.

blocks.prompt: 6 (a) A cannonball is fired from the ground at an angle \(30^{\circ}\) with an initial velocity of 100 m/s. Assuming gravity acts downward (\(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^{2}\)) and neglecting air resistance. Formulate the position vector \(\mathbf{r}(t)\) of the cannonball as a function of time.
blocks.explanation:
Sab se pehle dekhte hain ke yeh projectile (phenki hui cheez) ka sawal hai, bilkul 11.1.3 ke Example 1 jaisa.
Diya kya hai? Raftaar 100 m/s, angle \(30^{\circ}\), aur \(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^{2}\).
Find kya karna hai? Position vector \(\mathbf{r}(t)\).
Rule: horizontal harkat ek jaisi raftaar se hoti hai (hawa ki rukawat nahin), aur vertical harkat ko gravity dheema karti hai.
Plan: velocity ke do hisse nikalo, phir dono components jor kar \(\mathbf{r}(t)\) likho.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(v_{0} = 100\) m/s, \(\theta = 30^{\circ}\), \(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^{2}\).
Maloom karna: \(\mathbf{r}(t)\).
Tareeqa: phenkne wali jagah ko origin maanein, \(\hat{i}\) zameen ke saath (horizontal) aur \(\hat{j}\) seedha upar. 11.1.3 (Example 1) ka projectile model yeh hai:
\[\mathbf{r}(t) = (v_{0}\cos\theta)\,t\,\hat{i}\]
\[\quad + \left((v_{0}\sin\theta)\,t - \tfrac{1}{2}gt^{2}\right)\hat{j}\]
Yeh model is liye theek hai ke sawal ne hawa ki rukawat chhorne ko kaha hai.

Initial velocity ke hisse
\[v_{0}\cos 30^{\circ} = 100 \times \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = 50\sqrt{3}\]
\[v_{0}\sin 30^{\circ} = 100 \times \dfrac{1}{2} = 50\]
\[\tfrac{1}{2}g = \tfrac{1}{2}(9.8) = 4.9\]
Kyun: velocity ko do hisson mein torte hain: zameen ke saath wala hissa \(v_{0}\cos\theta\) aur upar wala hissa \(v_{0}\sin\theta\). Gravity oonchai mein \(-\frac{1}{2}gt^{2}\) jorti hai, kyunke woh har second neeche ki raftaar barhati hai.
Dhyan dein: \(\cos 30^{\circ} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\) aur \(\sin 30^{\circ} = \frac{1}{2}\); inhein ulat dena aam ghalti hai.

Position vector
\[\mathbf{r}(t) = 50\sqrt{3}\,t\,\hat{i}\]
\[\quad + (50t - 4.9t^{2})\hat{j}\]
Number mein \(50\sqrt{3} \approx 86.60\), to \(\mathbf{r}(t) \approx 86.60\,t\,\hat{i} + (50t - 4.9t^{2})\hat{j}\) (metres).
Kyun: teenon values model mein rakh di. \(\hat{i}\) wala hissa batata hai gola kitna aage gaya, aur \(\hat{j}\) wala hissa batata hai kitna ooncha hai.

Tasdeeq
\(t = 0\) par \(\mathbf{r}(0) = \mathbf{0}\), yani gola phenkne wali jagah par hai. Aur \(\mathbf{r}'(0) = 50\sqrt{3}\,\hat{i} + 50\,\hat{j}\) ki lambai \(\sqrt{7500 + 2500} = 100\) m/s hai aur angle \(\tan^{-1}\frac{50}{50\sqrt{3}} = 30^{\circ}\), bilkul jaisa diya gaya tha.

blocks.prompt: 6 (b) A cannonball is fired from the ground at an angle \(30^{\circ}\) with an initial velocity of 100 m/s. Assuming gravity acts downward (\(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^{2}\)) and neglecting air resistance. Find the velocity vector at \(t = 5\) sec.
blocks.explanation:
Velocity position ka derivative hai, aur position humein part (a) mein mil chuki hai.
Diya kya hai? \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 50\sqrt{3}\,t\,\hat{i} + (50t - 4.9t^{2})\hat{j}\).
Find kya karna hai? \(t = 5\) second par velocity vector.
Plan: pehle \(\mathbf{r}(t)\) ko differentiate kar ke \(\mathbf{v}(t)\), phir \(t = 5\) rakho, aur aakhir mein dekho ke is ka matlab kya hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: part (a) se \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 50\sqrt{3}\,t\,\hat{i} + (50t - 4.9t^{2})\hat{j}\).
Maloom karna: \(\mathbf{v}(5)\).
Tareeqa: \(\mathbf{v}(t) = \mathbf{r}'(t)\), har component alag.

Velocity
\[\mathbf{v}(t) = 50\sqrt{3}\,\hat{i} + (50 - 9.8t)\hat{j}\]
Kyun: \(50\sqrt{3}\,t\) ka derivative \(50\sqrt{3}\) (constant times \(t\)), aur \(50t - 4.9t^{2}\) ka derivative \(50 - 9.8t\) (power rule).

\(t = 5\) par
\[\mathbf{v}(5) = 50\sqrt{3}\,\hat{i} + (50 - 49)\hat{j}\]
\[= 50\sqrt{3}\,\hat{i} + \hat{j}\]
\[\approx 86.60\,\hat{i} + 1.00\,\hat{j}\]
Kyun: \(9.8 \times 5 = 49\), to vertical hissa sirf 1 m/s bacha.
Dhyan dein: \(t = 5\) ko \(\mathbf{r}(t)\) mein rakh dena (position) aur velocity mein rakhna do alag cheezein hain; yahan velocity poochi gayi hai.

Matlab
\[|\mathbf{v}(5)| = \sqrt{(50\sqrt{3})^{2} + 1^{2}}\]
\[= \sqrt{7501} \approx 86.61 \text{ m/s}\]
Vertical hissa chhota aur positive hai, yani gola abhi bhi bohat aahista upar ja raha hai; woh sab se oonchi jagah par tab pohanchega jab \(50 - 9.8t = 0\), yani \(t \approx 5.10\) s par. Horizontal raftaar \(50\sqrt{3}\) shuru se aakhir tak wohi rehti hai.
Kyun: hawa ki rukawat nahin, to aage ki raftaar ko koi nahin rokta; gravity sirf upar wali raftaar ko kam karti hai, jaise upar phenki gend aahista aahista rukti hai.

blocks.prompt: 6 (c) A cannonball is fired from the ground at an angle \(30^{\circ}\) with an initial velocity of 100 m/s. Assuming gravity acts downward (\(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^{2}\)) and neglecting air resistance. Determine the time of the flight (when the cannonball hits the ground).
blocks.explanation:
Gola zameen par tab hota hai jab us ki oonchai, yani \(\hat{j}\) wala component, zero ho.
Diya kya hai? Oonchai \(y(t) = 50t - 4.9t^{2}\).
Find kya karna hai? Woh waqt (zero ke ilawa) jab gola wapas zameen par girta hai.
Plan: \(50t - 4.9t^{2} = 0\) ko factorise kar ke hal karo, aur \(t = 0\) wala jawab chhor do kyunke woh phenkne ka lamha hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: part (a) se oonchai \(y(t) = 50t - 4.9t^{2}\).
Maloom karna: time of flight \(T\).
Tareeqa: zameen par oonchai zero hoti hai, to \(y(t) = 0\) hal karenge.

Oonchai ko zero rakhein
\[50t - 4.9t^{2} = 0\]
\[t(50 - 4.9t) = 0\]
\[t = 0 \ \text{ or } \ t = \dfrac{50}{4.9} = \dfrac{500}{49}\]
Kyun: \(t\) common nikala; do cheezon ka product tab zero hota hai jab un mein se koi ek zero ho. \(t = 0\) to woh lamha hai jab gola zameen se chala, is liye girne ka waqt doosra root hai.
Dhyan dein: \(t\) se dono taraf divide kar dene se \(t = 0\) wala root chhup jata hai; behtar hai factorise karein aur phir soch kar chhorein.

Value
\[T = \dfrac{500}{49} \approx 10.20 \text{ s}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{50}{4.9}\) mein upar neeche 10 se multiply kiya to \(\frac{500}{49}\) bana, jo taqreeban 10.204 hai.

Tasdeeq
\[T = \dfrac{2v_{0}\sin\theta}{g} = \dfrac{2(100)(0.5)}{9.8}\]
\[= \dfrac{100}{9.8} \approx 10.20 \text{ s}\]
Physics ka mashhoor time-of-flight formula bhi yahi deta hai. (Is dauran gola taqreeban \(50\sqrt{3} \times \frac{500}{49} \approx 883.70\) m door girta hai.)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Kitab mein Exercise 11.3 ke jawab chhape hue nahin hain (Unit 11 ki kisi exercise ke jawab kitab mein nahin hain). Is page ka har jawab hamara apna hai: qadam ba qadam hal kiya gaya, computer algebra system (sympy) se alag se check kiya gaya, aur ek solution book se bhi milaya gaya. \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\) jaise angles radians mein hain, is liye calculator RAD mode mein rakhein. Apna hal yahan wale hal se mila kar dekhiye.
